requirements.text:  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including shipping and operating production web applications end to end.
 Full\-stack proficiency: a modern front end (TypeScript/React or similar) and backend services (TypeScript or Python), with strong relational database skills (PostgreSQL or similar).
 Experience designing data models for entity\-centric domains—people, organizations, and relationships—including deduplication, identity resolution, and change history.
 Hands\-on experience building or extending role\- and attribute\-based access controls, with a working grasp of least\-privilege design.
 Experience integrating third\-party SaaS platforms via REST APIs and webhooks.
 Experience handling PII or otherwise sensitive data in production systems.
 Demonstrated ability to operate as a sole or founding engineer on a product: comfort with ambiguity, prioritization, and documentation.
 Strong communication skills, with the ability to work directly with non\-technical stakeholders.
 Experience integrating ATS/HRIS platforms (Greenhouse, Workday, Lever, or similar).
 Experience building CRM systems, or deep familiarity with CRM data models.
 Exposure to GDPR or comparable privacy and data\-protection regimes.
 Experience with graph data models or entity\-resolution systems.
 Experience embedding AI/LLM capabilities (search, matching, summarization) into applications.
 Prior experience in a hedge fund or investment\-management environment, or partnering closely with business development or investor relations teams.
